claim: A Union of Concerned Scientists analysis projects $1.6 trillion in avoided climate and health damages by 2035 if data centres are powered by clean energy, with much larger avoided damages by 2050.
comparisonContext: This is the strongest quantified upside claim in the new benefits material, though it remains model-based.
scopeNote: Modeled scenario result rather than an observed outcome.
sourceTitle: Powering Data Centers with Clean Energy Could Avoid Trillions in Climate and Health Costs
